title: Duwisib Castle

buildingCutout.basis: Named OpenStreetMap way 187024367 maps the four stone ranges and projecting gate tower.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the centerline of the principal southern gate. The continuous sandstone foundation covers the sampled perimeter variation.

identities.name: Duwisib Castle
identities.address: Duwisib Castle, D826, southwest of Maltahöhe, Hardap Region, Namibia

mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap way 187024367 fixes the outline, orientation and measured 35.1 by 30.7 m quadrangle. The western and rear profiles follow the Friedrich Lange postcard pair.

note: Postcard scans establish the relative height of the tower and parapets, the front arched gate and overhanging oriel, narrow arched stone openings and corbel bands.
